io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.usageNotes: Search last-minute hotels for tonight or tomorrow, inspect property facts and compare room offers. Private RoomLast price bands are masked. Exact prices, sign-in, booking and payment continue on roomlast.com. The MCP tools never create reservations or take payments; availability can change.
